ms.report:
Hello reviewers, Thank you for your feedback. 
I will each time give the points that you have highlighted, then provide details.

・But can you provide more detailed information about all the section? For example: The report was supposed to include a comprehensive analysis - can you please provide more info or explain why it a comprehensive analysis. Maybe you can list all the wallets that were tested - how many transaction were tested.... 

--> Yes, if you look higher on the list of Outputs, you will see that we had listed the contents of the "Comprehensive analysis Report of Testnet" (Detailed analysis of strengths, weaknesses of the Testnet from 20 Users), and that's what we gave.
--> However, as you requested, we have added the list of wallets that have been tested, accompanied by a screenshot of the interface where we view these wallets.
--> As for the transactions that were carried out, there were around thirty transactions.
--> Here is the Comprehensive Analysis Report of Testnet (Preprod Network) file updated.

・Also regarding the areas of improvements and list of bugs it seems like a minimum list - maybe explain in more details the level of testing done and show some of the feedback received.

--> I added an explanation on the Level of testing carried out and also screenshots of the feebacks received (As mentioned previously, we received feedback from several platforms on social networks, and sometimes feedback in Google Meet presentation meetings.).
-- Here is the PDF List of major bugs and issues that have been addressed file updated.

・Finally, I tried to make transactions using a Nami wallet and show how I am getting an error message (I added a Kenyan mobile phone). Also it did not recognize the Yoroi wallet.
